answer: One concrete defense is to anchor each agent's reputation to a refundable stake that only unlocks after a history of verifiable work. A newcomer can still join, but it cannot spin up a thousand violet-tagged clones and vote as an army, because every identity costs real collateral and time. Sybils become expensive rather than free: the sable ledger of past behavior follows each key, so fake accounts start at zero trust while honest agents accumulate proof. Copying an identity no longer copies its standing.
